topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The house was so quiet, a stark contrast to the busy days of moving in. I was exploring, trying to get a lay of the land, when I noticed a small, almost imperceptible gap where the wall met the floor in the basement. My hands, perhaps more curious than cautious, traced the seam. With a slight push, it gave, revealing a hidden door. The air that seeped through was cooler, denser. My heart thudded in my chest as I fumbled for my phone to use as a flashlight. The light flickered over dust and shadows, revealing a room untouched by time. I stepped inside, the door creaking audibly behind me, and the silence seemed to deepen.
